title: Claude Code Tutorial for Beginners (Windows + Opus 5.5)
title_alternatives: Claude Code From Zero: Build a Real App on Windows
I Built an App With Claude Code in 6 Minutes (Opus 5.5)
description:
A real Claude Code tutorial for beginners, recorded on Windows from a fresh install. Opus 5.5 plans and builds a working Pomodoro focus timer (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) from one paragraph, then we add features, fix a real bug and commit to git.

Everything on screen is real: one Claude Code session (v2.1.283, Opus 5.5, Claude Max plan), no cuts to the code, waiting parts sped up and marked.

What you'll learn:
• Install Claude Code on Windows with one PowerShell line
• Log in, pick a model with /model, switch modes with Shift+Tab
• Plan mode first, then build
• /init and CLAUDE.md, @file mentions
• Esc to stop, Esc Esc to rewind, commit with git

Install (from the official docs):
Windows: irm https://claude.ai/install.ps1 | iex
macOS / Linux: curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash

0:00 What we're building
0:36 Install and log in
1:09 Model and modes
1:38 Plan first
2:24 Claude builds it
3:03 Read the code
3:30 Add a feature
3:54 CLAUDE.md and git
4:14 Session two: ask, fix, undo
5:27 Five tips and the verdict

Sources:
• Claude Code setup (install commands): https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup
• Authentication and plans: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/authentication
• Permission modes (Shift+Tab): https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permission-modes
• Best practices: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/best-practices

Made with AI tools; stories based on a real AI-agent company.

tr.description:
Yeni başlayanlar için gerçek bir Claude Code eğitimi, Windows'ta sıfır kurulumdan kaydedildi. Opus 5.5 tek bir paragraftan çalışan bir Pomodoro odak zamanlayıcısı (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) planlayıp inşa ediyor; sonra özellik ekliyor, gerçek bir hatayı düzeltiyor ve git'e commit ediyoruz.

Ekrandaki her şey gerçek: Claude Code oturumu (v2.1.283, Opus 5.5, Claude Max planı), bekleme kısımları hızlandırıldı ve belirtildi.

Öğrenecekleriniz:
• Claude Code'u Windows'a tek PowerShell satırıyla kurmak
• Giriş, /model ile model seçimi, Shift+Tab ile modlar
• Önce plan modu, sonra inşa
• /init ve CLAUDE.md, @dosya
• Esc ile durdurmak, Esc Esc ile geri almak, git commit

Kurulum (resmi dokümanlardan):
Windows: irm https://claude.ai/install.ps1 | iex
macOS / Linux: curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash
